scripts.typecheck: pnpm --dir apps/web exec next typegen && pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck && tsc -p tsconfig.packages.json
scripts.test: pnpm --dir apps/web test && pnpm --dir packages/sdk test
scripts.lint: eslint apps/web packages examples && node scripts/check-boundary.mjs
scripts.validate:content: pnpm --dir apps/web exec node --conditions=react-server --import tsx scripts/validate-content.ts
scripts.check:launch: pnpm --dir apps/web exec node --env-file-if-exists=.env.local --conditions=react-server --import tsx scripts/check-launch.ts
